useLazyQuery: @apollo/client: React hook running a query on demand
useSuspenseQuery: @apollo/client: React hook running a query under Suspense
useBackgroundQuery: @apollo/client: React hook starting a query early
useLoadableQuery: @apollo/client: React hook running a query on demand
query: @apollo/client: client method, and the document key it takes
mutation: @apollo/client: document key on the mutate options
subscription: @apollo/client: document key on the subscribe options
uri: @apollo/client: the endpoint option on ApolloClient and its HTTP links
HttpLink: @apollo/client: the HTTP transport link class, constructed with a uri
createHttpLink: @apollo/client: factory form of HttpLink, same options
